items.note: Judged against the captain-authorized decision react-forms-lab-scope option A: full scope is kept, tasks 1-3 run in the S32 slot and tasks 4-8 on S33 after the teach-then-check steps. lab.json cleanup.notes (line 84) now give the two-slot sequencing and the interim P3-P5 framing. README.md lines 43-46 add 'When to do the tasks'. module.json sourceCoverageNotes now say the lab covers six topics with the same sequencing. topic.json files are unchanged, as the decision specifies. Learners are no longer directed to S33 work before it is taught.

Judged against the course-owner directive 95387e98 and decision option A. minutes stay 25/30 (lines 86-89), and notes now state honestly that the allowance covers the whole two-slot task set and is planning evidence, not a measured pilot. The plausibility concern is superseded by that directive, not disproved.

README.md lines 63-65 and 119-120 now tell learners that test 8 only proves their own test passes and that its demonstrations are self-checked. starter/src/service-form.test.jsx line 36 adds expect.hasAssertions(), so an emptied test no longer passes. The lab.json honor-verified note is kept. This meets the disclosure option of the original recommendation; there is still no mutation check, but none is now claimed.

Steps 3 and 5 (lines 10-17) now say findBy for appearing, queryBy ... not.toBeInTheDocument() for absence ('findBy rejects when it is missing'), waitFor if needed, and user.selectOptions for the team select. The contradiction is gone. The private reference learner test passes 8/8 on the final snapshot in a scratch run.

README.md lines 60-62 now disclose that tests 4-7 build on tasks 1-3 and that test 7 needs the task 6 toast. Line 112 adds 'announce "Service deleted"' to the task 6 summary, and the files list notes that test 7 also exercises OverviewPage.jsx. The test 3 on task 4 coupling (edu-fcc-r1) is now removed too.

The 'Task 4's test hangs' entry is replaced (lines 150-152) by 'Test 5 cannot find the Save service button after a server error ... reset the pending state in a finally block'. This matches the actual failure signature when the button keeps its pending label, which is how the reference renders it ('Saving...').
TASK 2 (lines 28-31) now says 'The team caption is a <span>; make it a <label> first.'

tests/t3-client-validation.test.jsx lines 22-32 now spy on Event.prototype.preventDefault and require at least one cancelled submit event, so controlled-forms#o2's preventDefault clause is scored. On the shipped starter, test 3 fails there with 'handleSubmit must call event.preventDefault(): expected 0 to be greater than 0' (observed on the final 30cd7583 bytes). README troubleshooting (lines 153-154) also maps the jsdom 'requestSubmit' trace to a missing preventDefault.

The optional block now starts 'from the tests folder' and uses 'cd ../starter' (line 35). A note follows that the dev server keeps the terminal busy and tests run from tests in a second terminal (Ctrl+C to stop).

The release block (lines 60-67) now waits only for the 'Saving' pending button to go, not for the created overview card, so test 3 no longer depends on a working task 4. Observed on the final bytes in a scratch copy with the private reference: with createService posting to '/api/service' (a task-4 bug), test 3 passes and only tests 4, 5 and 7 fail. The unmodified reference passes 8/8, and the shipped starter still fails all 8 under the declared names.

The preventDefault assertion now carries the message 'handleSubmit must call event.preventDefault()'. Observed on the shipped starter: test 3 fails with 'handleSubmit must call event.preventDefault(): expected 0 to be greater than 0', which names the fix.
